title: World War B: Bugfront
description: A fast, style-ranked browser FPS. Hold the Bugfront against 8 waves of masked mercenaries, Sentinel robots, robot hounds and Exo heavies, then break The Warden with rifles, shotguns, rockets and Overdrive.

defaultCaptions.x: Survived 8 waves of World War B: Bugfront, a browser FPS against masked mercs, humanoid robots, exosuits and a boss mech. Can you break The Warden?
defaultCaptions.facebook: World War B: Bugfront is a fast, style-ranked first-person wave shooter that runs right in your browser. M4, M870, RPG-X and frags versus masked mercenaries, robot hounds, exosuits and The Warden.
defaultCaptions.reddit: World War B: Bugfront, a browser push-forward FPS with a style meter, augment picks between waves, and a boss fight against The Warden
defaultCaptions.discord: World War B: Bugfront. 8 waves, 1 Warden, S-rank or bust. Beat my score!
